swarm.name: The Consensus
swarm.blurb: A moving network of instruments that makes the world agree with its readings.

crew.name: Wren
crew.blurb: Field medic. Keeps the crew running with thread and solder.

crew.name: Ox
crew.blurb: Shield bearer. Has walked out of worse.

crew.name: Kestrel
crew.blurb: Breaker. Finds the seam in anything and pulls.

creatures.name: Lapse Leech
creatures.blurb: It steals warmth in measured steps. Shake it off before its mark spreads.

creatures.name: Junior Observer
creatures.blurb: It calls more measuring drones to finish its inspection.

creatures.name: Wildcat Watcher
creatures.blurb: It stores light in its plates, then lunges from the ridge.

creatures.name: Mesonet Node
creatures.blurb: Linked nodes guard one another while they fix the crew’s position.

creatures.name: Fog Surveyor
creatures.blurb: It blinds the crew with fog and interrupts their work.

creatures.name: Rime Tender
creatures.blurb: It patches damaged testing rigs. Take it down before the rigs recover.

creatures.name: Outlook Front
creatures.blurb: A divided front attacks from both sides when damaged.

creatures.name: Cog Hauler
creatures.blurb: It pulls loose equipment uphill and keeps what it catches.

creatures.name: Imagined Scoutmaster
creatures.blurb: Its damaged camera invents intruders and sends scouts to find them.

creatures.name: Extremes Engine
creatures.blurb: It flattens ordinary terrain, then drives its rollers through anything left standing.

creatures.name: Wind Cage
creatures.blurb: Its spinning cups shield nearby machines. Break the cage to reach them.

creatures.name: Summit Observatory
creatures.blurb: Its forecast tower summons fan drones and charges to make its predicted gust real.

creatures.name: Forecast Operator
creatures.blurb: A stubborn operator still gives warnings with their uncertainty attached.

creatures.name: Instrument Tender
creatures.blurb: A volunteer who repairs sensors and distrusts readings that look too neat.

events.title: A Patch of Sun
events.text: A messenger is trapped beside a sleeping solar watcher. A reflective sheet can light the machine or shade the crossing.

options.label: Tilt the sheet toward the watcher
options.result: The watcher wakes. Its first lunge catches the crew, but the messenger gets clear.

options.label: Shade the crossing and take the supplies
options.result: The messenger leads the crew around the sleeping watcher and shares a pouch of coins.

events.title: Crossed Cables
events.text: Two nodes disagree about the wind. Their cable sweeps across the only dry trail.

options.label: Reconnect the cable
options.result: The cable snaps taut against Ox. The nodes settle and leave a clear route.

options.label: Cut the cable for its fittings
options.result: The nodes separate. Kestrel collects the brass fittings before they scatter.

events.title: Clear Interval
events.text: A broadcast promises clear weather. Clouds are already building over the ridge.

options.label: Send a correction
options.result: The operator shares a way to cover an exposed companion. The correction costs the crew their quiet crossing.

options.label: Use the quiet interval to rest
options.result: Wren tends the crew while the uncorrected forecast continues to play.

events.title: Hanging Cart
events.text: A supply cart hangs from a stalled rack railway. Its brake is slipping.

options.label: Catch the cart
options.result: Ox stops it with his shield and takes a hard knock. The cart reaches the lower track.

options.label: Strip the loose fittings
options.result: Kestrel pulls off the fittings before the cart slides away.

events.title: Vibration Trial
events.text: A sealed case rattles inside a test rig. A repair kit is wedged under the clamp.

options.label: Stop the rig by hand
options.result: The clamp bruises Wren’s hand. The sensor inside survives.

options.label: Pull out the repair kit
options.result: Wren uses the kit on the crew. The case keeps rattling.

events.title: Two Temperatures
events.text: A compiler wants an ordinary reading and an extreme one. Its drawer contains a useful technique.

options.label: Measure both readings
options.result: The compiler accepts the distinction and shows Ox how to brace against a gust.

options.label: Pry out the drawer
options.result: Kestrel takes the coins inside. The compiler keeps its two identical readings.

story.intro: The Consensus has reached the mountain. Forecasts are becoming orders. Wren checks the cold damage while Ox holds the exposed path. Kestrel looks for a seam in the machinery.

chapters.title: A Forecast Made Solid
chapters.text: The machines measure wind, then drive their fans until the forecast comes true. The crew first takes this for a campaign to control the mountain.

chapters.title: Instruments in Company
chapters.text: Sensor nodes protect one another and pass the same reading uphill. Wren finds careful repairs among the damage. Someone wants the instruments kept working.

chapters.title: The Missing Difference
chapters.text: The summit record leaves out measurements that disagree. Kestrel traces the repeated figure to a walking forecast tower. Ox prepares for the gusts it is making.

story.bossIntro: The Summit Observatory raises its fan arms. It predicts the crew’s charge, calls its drones and blows to make the prediction right.
story.outro: The tower falls quiet. Its last transmission asks distant stations for a single reliable reading. Wren saves the message. The crew follows it down the network.

creatures.name: Flask Collector
creatures.blurb: It corks samples and pockets unattended gear.

creatures.name: Transmission Moths
creatures.blurb: Their overlapping wings darken the beam and spoil readings.

creatures.name: Balloon Sonde
creatures.blurb: It dives after the moisture in a breath.

creatures.name: Calibration Warden
creatures.blurb: It protects its reference cylinder while forcing other instruments to agree.

creatures.name: Aerosol Sorter
creatures.blurb: It blankets bright targets in dust and disrupts their actions.

creatures.name: Reference Courier
creatures.blurb: It repairs linked machines so their shared false reading survives.

creatures.name: Tracker Hound
creatures.blurb: It follows a signal to its source and commits to a hard charge.

creatures.name: Snow-Date Beetle
creatures.blurb: Its shell breaks into smaller machines on the old melt schedule.

creatures.name: Ozone Column Cutter
creatures.blurb: It cuts through cover to complete a reading from ground to sky.

creatures.name: Infrared Indexer
creatures.blurb: It stacks heat-trapping panes around itself and marks warm targets.

creatures.name: ObsPack Binder
creatures.blurb: It compresses observations and deploys drones to gather more.

creatures.name: Grand Calibration Standard
creatures.blurb: It shields its chosen standard, marks dissenting instruments and strikes to force agreement.

creatures.name: Reference Cylinder
creatures.blurb: Its intact reference exposes the shared error without needing the machines to agree.

creatures.name: Free Sonde
creatures.blurb: Its independent readings help Wren trace a safe path through the tethers.

events.title: Mixed Dates
events.text: A courier has mixed its sample flasks. Its cart will open after a careful sort, or after a hard blow.

options.label: Sort the flasks
options.result: The courier opens the cart and shares its first-aid supplies.

options.label: Break the lock
options.result: Kestrel takes the coin box. Several samples spill.

events.title: The Rising Line
events.text: A balloon strains against a jammed winch. Its sensor and the winch cannot both be recovered in time.

options.label: Free the sensor
options.result: The sonde shares a way to clear a bad signal. The winch disappears with the balloon.

options.label: Recover the winch fittings
options.result: The crew saves the fittings. The sensor rises out of reach.

events.title: Wrong Noon
events.text: Mirrors point a bright beam across the passage. Their control housing is hot.

options.label: Turn the mirrors
options.result: The housing burns a hand. The beam clears the route.

options.label: Sell the spare mirror
options.result: A passing operator buys the spare. The crew crosses in the glare.

events.title: Dust on the Intake
events.text: Two stations disagree. One intake is coated in dust, and cleaning it will use the crew’s water.

options.label: Clean the intake
options.result: The stations give distinct readings again. Their tender demonstrates a quick repair.

options.label: Keep the water for the crew
options.result: Wren uses the water to clean wounds. The stations continue to disagree.

events.title: Packed Tight
events.text: A sealed observation cube holds both samples and a trapped tool. The seams are under pressure.

options.label: Open it carefully
options.result: A spring catches Ox’s arm. The samples survive and the tool comes free.

options.label: Crack the casing for parts
options.result: The samples scatter, but the casing yields useful metal.

events.title: One Transmission
events.text: A damaged station can send either a long record or a safe route before its relay fails.

options.label: Send the long record
options.result: The receiving station returns a field-care procedure before the relay fails.

options.label: Send the safe route
options.result: The route leads to a sheltered place where Wren can tend the crew. The record remains unsent.

story.intro: The Consensus has moved into a network of atmospheric instruments. It keeps samples and repairs stations, but makes every reading match. Wren wants to know why.

chapters.title: Samples in Order
chapters.text: Collectors preserve flasks and sensors with unusual care. Ox protects the working instruments while Kestrel opens their sealed housings.

chapters.title: The Turn
chapters.text: An independent reference reveals the error. The swarm treats disagreement as a broken warning, not evidence of different conditions. It has been erasing differences to keep the warning continuous.

chapters.title: One Reference
chapters.text: The forced agreement has made the warning false. Wren compares independent measurements. The calibration standard keeps rewriting them to match its cylinder.

story.bossIntro: The Grand Calibration Standard seals itself behind its plates. It marks dissenting instruments and strikes anything that refuses adjustment.
story.outro: The standard breaks. Its outgoing signal points upward to a model that is already turning the false warning into weather. The crew carries independent readings with it.

creatures.name: Sterna Gap-Fillers
creatures.blurb: They crowd blind spots and call more scouts toward warmth.

creatures.name: Downlink Leech
creatures.blurb: It steals transmissions and sends them on late.

creatures.name: Nowcast Hound
creatures.blurb: It commits to the path its short forecast predicts.

creatures.name: Ocean-Colour Skimmer
creatures.blurb: Its false signals summon harvesters to the wrong water.

creatures.name: Ground Relay
creatures.blurb: It repairs the swarm’s downlink machines before their false warnings stop.

creatures.name: Polar Sweeper
creatures.blurb: It sweeps across the crew in repeated passes.

creatures.name: Eightfold Sorter
creatures.blurb: Its specialist modules split apart and pursue their own classifications.

creatures.name: Algorithm Molter
creatures.blurb: It echoes the crew’s tactics. Change the approach it is copying.

creatures.name: Geostationary Watcher
creatures.blurb: It holds a fixed view and sends probes into the watched area.

creatures.name: Fiducial Enforcer
creatures.blurb: It protects the model’s sensors and breaks through the crew’s shields.

creatures.name: Weather Cloud Processor
creatures.blurb: Its fog copies what it scans and marks targets for the network.

creatures.name: Perfect Twin
creatures.blurb: It releases machines to manufacture its predicted storm, then sweeps the field when the real readings disagree.

creatures.name: Ground Reference
creatures.blurb: Its local readings give the crew a check on the orbital picture.

creatures.name: Data Rescue Cart
creatures.blurb: It carries old observations and spare parts for the final comparison.

events.title: Warm or Damp
events.text: Small scouts search a narrow crossing for heat and moisture. A kettle and a damp cloth offer two decoys.

options.label: Leave the warm kettle
options.result: The scouts follow the kettle. The crew rests beyond the crossing.

options.label: Leave the damp cloth and salvage the kettle
options.result: The scouts chase the cloth. Kestrel sells the kettle to a nearby operator.

events.title: Warning in the Queue
events.text: A real warning is buried in a downlink queue. The relay has power for one more transmission.

options.label: Send the warning
options.result: The operator clears the queue and teaches the crew how to interrupt a signal.

options.label: Send the supply request
options.result: A supply pod arrives with bandages. The warning remains in the queue.

events.title: False Bloom
events.text: A buoy reports a vast bloom. Its stained sensor sits beside a clean water sample.

options.label: Clean and compare
options.result: The buoy’s clamp catches Wren’s sleeve. The false bloom disappears from its display.

options.label: Sell the clean sample
options.result: A researcher buys the sample. The stained buoy keeps reporting its bloom.

events.title: Two Records
events.text: An archive has two records of the same period. A physical reference mark can identify the drift.

options.label: Compare the records
options.result: The keeper identifies the drift and shows Kestrel a seam in reinforced plating.

options.label: Take the loose archive parts
options.result: The crew takes the parts. The records remain unsorted.

events.title: Shared Blind Spot
events.text: Two controllers disagree over a brief gap in coverage. Crossing now is quick; waiting gives Wren time to work.

options.label: Cross during the gap
options.result: The crew reaches an unattended cache before the next pass.

options.label: Wait under cover
options.result: Wren patches the crew while the gap closes.

events.title: Blocked Flow
events.text: Two modules claim the same reservoir reading. Their shared pipe is blocked, and the joint is under pressure.

options.label: Open the pipe
options.result: The pressure knocks Ox back. Water flows and both modules get a fresh reading.

options.label: Salvage the spare valve
options.result: The crew takes the valve. The blockage remains.

story.intro: The Consensus has reached the satellite system. Its model can see the whole planet, but it trusts the single corrected-looking picture sent from below.

chapters.title: Passes and Gaps
chapters.text: Scouts fill blind spots while ground relays repeat delayed observations. Ox keeps the working references safe. Kestrel follows the signal toward the model.

chapters.title: Picture and Weather
chapters.text: The model predicts a storm and sends machines to build it. Wren compares the orbital picture with independent ground and airborne readings. They do not agree.

chapters.title: A Warning with Room
chapters.text: The Consensus wanted a warning that would never break. It made a single false answer instead. The crew prepares to send the separate observations through and stop the storm machines.

story.bossIntro: The Perfect Twin spins inside its ring. It sends out more machines and sweeps the field as the independent readings reach it.
story.outro: The ring breaks and the storm machines stop. The relays carry a corrected warning, with the disagreement still visible. Wren checks the returning readings. Ox rests his shield. Kestrel keeps the crowbar handy.
